requirements.promised_behavior: Audit named papers/implementations and compare faithfully configured baselines.
requirements.implemented_behavior: The source-to-implementation audit still distinguishes DriftLens and Domino from internal controls. Corrected post-hoc early/midpoint ADWIN sensitivity (fixed probes at batches 1 and 12) resolves short-delay strict-cap cold-start in 273/630 cells at delays 0 and 5, while increasing strict-cap audits; the first buggy attempt is explicitly superseded.

requirements.amendment_reason: This post-hoc diagnostic fills a prespecified localization measurement gap without tuning on monitoring truth.
requirements.allowed_claim: The target pair is localized reliably under the tested synthetic dependence intervention; tested cluster configurations poorly recover the generating region.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: One designed pair intervention and one synthetic regional generator do not imply arbitrary-shift or natural-domain localization; region recovery remains weak.

requirements.promised_behavior: Separate realized harm, expected harm, calibrated correctness, future risk and reference/calibrator uncertainty.
requirements.implemented_behavior: Historical/current estimators, scoped forecast experiments and 7/30/90-row calibrator/reference block sensitivity are supplemented with 200 training-only moving-block refits of the NOAA scoring pipeline. Each draw refits scaler, logistic model, PCA/clusters, isotonic calibrator and reference correctness while holding calibration/reference/monitor partitions fixed. The bootstrap interval contains the original fitted model estimate on all 21 batches; this is a descriptive consistency check, not coverage for true accuracy.
requirements.amendment_reason: Training-block resampling was added as a separate conditional sensitivity component; the 7/30/90-row calibration/reference resampling remains separately reported.
requirements.allowed_claim: On one NOAA chronology, the training-block refit interval for the calibrated accuracy estimate contains the original fitted model estimate on 21/21 batches. The original estimate MAE against observed accuracy remains 0.0443; bootstrap consistency does not establish coverage for truth or future accuracy.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: No model misspecification, unseen regime, new station/domain, or joint training/calibrator/reference population uncertainty guarantee is established; batches are serial and dependent.

requirements.promised_behavior: Separate scheduled and selected feedback; random audit inclusion probabilities and supported IPW.
requirements.implemented_behavior: Synthetic 30-seed known-probability selective-label evaluation plus a 1,000-draw retrospective sampling-design replay on the fixed NOAA monitoring chronology. Both separate feature-only acquisition from evaluator correctness and log selected-row inclusion probabilities; the NOAA replay exactly reproduces the locked batch accuracies.
requirements.amendment_reason: Synthetic known-probability acquisition and positivity/estimability distinctions were evaluated without representing simulated labels as natural prospective outcomes.
requirements.allowed_claim: For the fixed NOAA stream, targeted-only selection had zero inclusion probability outside the target and could not estimate population accuracy; adding a known-probability random audit yielded a design-based HT estimate with near-nominal empirical interval coverage across randomized draws. This is conditional on one retrospective stream.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: This is simulated retrospective sampling, not prospective natural-stream label operations or an independent-domain replication. It does not test nonresponse, label acquisition costs, changing/misspecified inclusion probabilities, or recalibration from selected labels.

requirements.promised_behavior: Strict cap and exact quota; full declared policy family, budget, and delay matrix; force-fills and unused budgets disclosed.
requirements.implemented_behavior: A locked outcome-informed replay evaluates six policies across strict-cap and exact-quota modes, budgets 2/4/8, delays 0/5/20/100, seven conditions, and 30 evaluation seeds. Decisions use current cached predictors and only previously selected labels satisfying source_batch + delay < decision_clock. Seed-level paired uncertainty averages matched conditions and budgets before resampling.
requirements.amendment_reason: The prior limited policy set is expanded into the declared full Cartesian matrix; the new run is additive and does not overwrite earlier analyses.
requirements.allowed_claim: The selected policies are compared on the preserved 30-seed synthetic evaluation under the explicitly logged budgets and delays. Delay 100 cannot verify labels within the 24-batch horizon. Strict-cap episode-yield differences are not equal-spend rankings because acquisition counts differ.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: This is outcome-informed replay on cached synthetic predictions, not fresh independent confirmation, prospective deployment, acquisition-cost validation, or evidence of analyst benefit. The tested policy family is not every Phase 2 policy concept.

requirements.promised_behavior: Static, periodic, global/local error-driven policies with equal opportunities and row-use budgets.
requirements.implemented_behavior: Two 30-seed adaptation comparisons now exist. The budget-trigger audit compares frozen, periodic, global-trigger and training-frozen-region local-trigger policies at delays 0/5/20. A separate matched-clock study gives global and cluster-local models the same released row-ID windows at four identical update clocks, with 2,000 rows per opportunity and an 8,000 cumulative repeated-fit-row cap; initial 4,000-row training is reported separately. The local policy partitions each common released window using a three-cluster training-frozen MiniBatchKMeans model and keeps the frozen global fallback for unsupported clusters. Strict source_batch + delay < forecast_batch timing and fit-level row-ID hashes are recorded. A fresh-seed diversity extension now evaluates the matched-clock global/local/frozen arms across linear, XOR and five-region tasks; stationary, gradual, recurrent and out-of-support mechanisms; and delays 0/5/20 (30 evaluation seeds, 3,240 cells). The 30-seed budget-trigger schedule was rerun through the shared LabelBroker: all 69,120 cohort releases are logged and verified; a corrected metric separates labels available at the final forecast from queue-drained labels.
requirements.amendment_reason: Added a matched-opportunity and matched released-row window extension, but the complete policy, mechanism, task and cost matrix requested by Phase 2 remains broader than these bounded studies.
requirements.allowed_claim: In the tested linear-probabilistic reversal stream, both matched adaptive arms improved mean accuracy over frozen by about 22 percentage points. Global refitting exceeded local refitting by 0.08–0.11 percentage points at delays 0/5/20, with paired 95% seed-bootstrap intervals excluding zero. In stationarity, both adaptive arms slightly reduced accuracy relative to frozen. Trigger-policy results are separately reported in the companion audit. These are generator- and schedule-specific findings.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: The fresh extension remains synthetic, uses one logistic classifier and a fixed three-cluster partition, and compares models with different capacity/compute. Its 36 setting intervals are unadjusted descriptive intervals; no natural-stream adaptation, matched compute/acquisition cost, alternative local thresholds, or analyst decision-effect evidence is established.

requirements.phase2_section: Supervised detector under delayed selective feedback
requirements.promised_behavior: Diagnose the one-probe strict-cap deadlock and verify a corrected fixed-probe sensitivity under the same seed, conditions, delays and cohort budgets.
requirements.implemented_behavior: Post-hoc early/midpoint probe sensitivity at batches 1 and 12; both probes are selected in all 5,040 cells. Delayed release, cost caps, hashes, 30-seed paired bootstrap and report reproduction are checked.
requirements.amendment_reason: Exploratory policy amendment motivated by strict-cap feedback deadlock; not confirmatory.

requirements.unresolved_limitation: Reuse of cached streams, post-hoc schedule, short 24-batch horizon, no natural-stream replication, no equal-spend strict-cap comparison.

requirements.promised_behavior: Test global and cluster-local refitting beyond one linear abrupt-reversal setting, holding clocks and released feedback windows fixed.
requirements.implemented_behavior: Fresh 30-seed matrix over three controlled task families, four mechanisms and delays 0/5/20; 3,240 seed-policy cells, 311,040 forecast rows and 17,280 fit-audit rows. Fresh seeds have no exact collisions in the declared text/archive scan. Matched feedback IDs, release clocks and row-use caps pass.
requirements.amendment_reason: Post-deadline experimental extension addresses narrow task/mechanism coverage; it does not replace the submitted Phase 2 methodology.
requirements.allowed_claim: Effects vary by task and mechanism; stationary XOR/five-region gains show the local architecture can benefit independently of drift adaptation.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: Simulation only; one classifier and cluster count; unequal model capacity and compute; unadjusted intervals across 36 settings; no natural-stream adaptation or human decision-effect evidence.

requirements.phase2_section: Impact-aware adaptation and fair comparison of global and region-specific evidence
requirements.promised_behavior: Determine whether the previously observed cluster-local refit gains are due to distinct local adaptation behavior or the cluster-conditional model capacity.
requirements.implemented_behavior: Corrected v2 experiment starts frozen/global/local/interaction arms from the same historical global model, then evaluates a pooled 27-parameter cluster-block logistic model against three local experts on identical streams, update clocks, feedback windows and release-safe labels. 30 seeds × 3 tasks × 4 mechanisms × 3 delays × 4 arms = 4,320 cells and 414,720 forecasts. The interaction and local arm all-stream mean accuracy differs by 0.0016 percentage points overall; interaction minus global is +1.4413 percentage points averaged by seed over all settings. A 20,000-resample paired max-t seed bootstrap provides simultaneous 95% intervals across 36 local-vs-global settings; 32 intervals exclude zero. Full output, paired bootstrap contrasts and fit audit are retained.
requirements.amendment_reason: Post-deadline fairness control. The invalid v1 arm initialization is retained but explicitly superseded by corrected v2; this does not change the submitted Phase 2 basis.
requirements.allowed_claim: Within these synthetic generators, the observed local-global gap is largely reproduced by a pooled cluster-conditional function class. This supports capacity/representation as a plausible explanation, not causal proof or evidence of general IDM-Viz benefit.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: Only one classifier family and one frozen three-cluster assignment; local-vs-interaction fit computation differs and numerical optimization need not be identical; 549 local region-level fits fall back to the initial global model; no independent natural-stream adaptation, human decision effect, or multiplicity-adjusted omnibus conclusion.

requirements.phase2_section: Empirical evaluation and reproducibility of matched global/cluster-conditional adaptation
requirements.promised_behavior: Check whether the corrected capacity-control pattern persists on evaluation seeds independent from the original adaptation diversity and capacity-control runs.
requirements.implemented_behavior: A separate config ran the unchanged corrected v2 runner on seeds 73116401--73116410: 1,440 cells, 138,240 forecasts and 7,200 fit-audit rows. Seed-collision scan found no matches in 3,097 text files/4,248 archive metadata members. Release-clock, feedback-hash, four-update, 8,000-row cap, and output-hash checks pass. Task-averaged local-minus-global accuracy was -0.176 pp (linear), +2.119 pp (XOR), and +1.508 pp (five-region); pooled interaction-minus-global had the same rounded pattern. The effects are reported separately from the 30-seed primary run.
requirements.amendment_reason: Fresh-seed post-deadline sensitivity check; no Phase 2 claim or submitted document changed.
requirements.allowed_claim: The task-level pattern is directionally consistent on this independent seed bank: cluster-conditional arms improve over global refitting on XOR/five-region and slightly underperform on linear in this synthetic protocol.
requirements.unresolved_limitation: Only 10 seeds and still the same synthetic generators, model family, fixed cluster count, mechanism design and one protocol; percentile intervals are exploratory, not adjusted across tasks, and this does not establish natural-domain generalization or causal benefit.
